metadata.description: The ESLStudeo plugin for Claude: build courses and run classes in ESLStudeo by talking to Claude.

plugins.name: eslstudeo
plugins.description: Build courses and run classes in ESLStudeo by talking to Claude. Plan and write units, pages and exercises; find and change wording across a course; check a course's quality; set a class's dates, access, attempts and exam resits; add or move learners; see how a class is getting on; mark written work; answer posts and messages; and write to the learners who need it, with a notice or email drafts. Includes the ESLStudeo connector, which you approve on eslstudeo.com.
